I took my dogs for grooming at Zoo & aquarium Pet Store. The work done there is great. Hose is very knowledgable. He immediately noticed one of my dogs had an ear infection and recommended a vet visit, which confirmed a serious infection. He also saw that their skin didn’t look healthy and suggested a new medicated shampoo. I’m grateful for his attentiveness.
The staff, including Hose, are all nice and welcoming, creating a comfortable atmosphere. Unlike other places where they couldn’t clip all my dog’s nails due to her restlessness, here the staff quickly and calmly got the job done without any issues.
It’s clear Hose loves his work and animals, always bringing a smile and positive energy. I highly recommend this grooming service!
